title: As If & Seeming: んばかり, とばかりに, ごとく / ごとき, めく, じみた, ぶる, ながらに
description: As if about to, as if to say, like (literary), showing signs of, smacking of, acting as if, and as one is (from birth / in tears).

points.title: 〜んばかりに / んばかりの: as if about to
points.summary: ない-stem + んばかり = so much that it seems A is about to happen (泣き出さんばかり, 割れんばかりの拍手).
points.body: - 彼女は泣き出さ**んばかりの**顔をしていた.
examples: {会場|かいじょう}は{割|わ}れんばかりの{拍手|はくしゅ}に{包|つつ}まれた。
The hall was filled with thunderous applause.

points.title: 「…」とばかりに: as if to say
points.summary: Quote + とばかりに = acting as if saying it (without actually saying it).
points.body: - 「早くしろ」**とばかりに**、彼は時計を指さした.
examples: {待|ま}ってましたとばかりに、{彼|かれ}は{話|はな}し{始|はじ}めた。
As if he'd been waiting for this, he started talking.

points.title: 〜ごとく / ごとき / ごとし: like (literary)
points.summary: かの / の + ごとく (adverb), ごとき + noun, ごとし (end). 私ごとき = humble 'the likes of me'.
points.body:
- 何もなかったかの**ごとく**振る舞った.
- 私**ごとき**者には無理です.
examples: {彼|かれ}は{何|なに}もなかったかのごとく{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}った。
He acted as if nothing had happened.

points.title: 〜めく / めいた: show signs of
points.summary: Noun + めく = take on the air of (春めく). めいた + noun: 皮肉めいた言い方.
points.body: - 日ざしも春**めいて**きた.
examples: {皮肉|ひにく}めいた{言|い}い{方|かた}をする。
He has a sarcastic way of putting things.

points.title: 〜じみた: smacking of (negative)
points.summary: Noun + じみた = has the (unwelcome) quality of: 子供じみた, 年寄りじみた.
points.body: - 大人なのに子供**じみた**ことを言うな.
examples: {大人|おとな}なのに{子供|こども}じみたことを{言|い}うな。
You're an adult — stop saying such childish things.

points.title: 〜ぶる: act as if, put on airs
points.summary: Adjective stem / noun + ぶる = pretend to be (上品ぶる, 偉ぶる, 知ったかぶり).
points.body: - 彼女はいつも上品**ぶって**いる.

points.title: 〜ながらに / ながらの: as (it is)
points.summary: Fixed phrases: 生まれながらに (from birth), 涙ながらに (in tears), 昔ながらの (as of old).
points.body:
- 生まれ**ながらに**才能に恵まれていた.
- 涙**ながらに**語った.
examples: {彼女|かのじょ}は{涙|なみだ}ながらに{事情|じじょう}を{語|かた}った。
She told the story in tears.

questions.prompt: {彼女|かのじょ}は{今|いま}にも{泣|な}き{出|だ}さ（　）{顔|かお}をしていた。
questions.explanation: As if about to (+ noun): **んばかりの**.
notes: んばかりに can't modify a noun.
泣き出さばかり isn't a form.
んがための = 'for the purpose of'.
questions.translation: She looked as though she might burst into tears at any moment.

questions.prompt: {彼|かれ}は「{帰|かえ}れ」と{言|い}わ（　）、ドアを{開|あ}けた。
notes: 言わばかりに isn't a form.
んばかりの needs a noun after it.
questions.translation: He opened the door as if to say 'get out'.

questions.prompt: 「{早|はや}くしろ」（　）、{彼|かれ}は{時計|とけい}を{指|ゆび}さした。
questions.explanation: As if to say: **とばかりに**.
questions.translation: He pointed at his watch as if to say 'hurry up'.

questions.prompt: What does 「{待|ま}ってましたとばかりに、{彼|かれ}は{話|はな}し{始|はじ}めた。」 mean?
options: As if he'd been waiting for this, he started talking.
He said he'd been waiting, then started talking.
He only started talking after waiting.
questions.explanation: とばかりに = **as if to say**.
notes: とばかりに = as if (he didn't actually say it).

questions.prompt: {彼|かれ}は{何|なに}もなかったかの（　）{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}った。
questions.translation: He acted as if nothing had happened.

questions.prompt: {私|わたし}（　）{者|もの}には、とてもできません。
notes: ごとく can't modify a noun.
questions.translation: Someone like me could never do it.

questions.prompt: {日|ひ}ざしもだんだん{春|はる}（　）きた。
questions.explanation: Showing signs of: **春めいてきた**.
questions.translation: The sunshine is gradually starting to feel like spring.

questions.prompt: {彼|かれ}はいつも{皮肉|ひにく}（　）{言|い}い{方|かた}をする。
notes: めいて can't modify a noun.
questions.translation: He always has a sarcastic way of putting things.

questions.prompt: {大人|おとな}なのに{子供|こども}（　）ことを{言|い}うな。
notes: ごとき = 'like / the likes of' — 子供ごとき isn't 'childish'.
questions.translation: You're an adult — stop saying such childish things.

questions.prompt: What does 「{年寄|としよ}りじみた{服|ふく}」 mean?
options: clothes that make you look like an old person
clothes an old person gave you
notes: じみた is a (negative) impression, not a target group.

questions.prompt: {彼女|かのじょ}はいつも{上品|じょうひん}（　）いるが、{本当|ほんとう}は{口|くち}が{悪|わる}い。
notes: ぶりに = 'for the first time in'.
ぶりで isn't the verb form.
questions.translation: She always acts refined, but actually she has a foul mouth.

questions.prompt: What does 「{彼|かれ}はすぐ{偉|えら}ぶる。」 mean?
{彼|かれ}は{生|う}まれ（　）{才能|さいのう}に{恵|めぐ}まれていた。
questions.translation: He was gifted with talent from birth.

questions.prompt: {彼女|かのじょ}は{涙|なみだ}（　）{事情|じじょう}を{語|かた}った。
notes: とばかりに follows a quote ('…' とばかりに), not 涙.
涙ながらも isn't the phrase.
questions.translation: She told the story in tears.
